description:
Convert images, audio and video from the Windows 11 right-click menu.

Jalyro Convert adds a "Convert to" entry to the Windows 11 context menu.
Select one file or hundreds, right-click, choose a format; the converted files
appear beside the originals. Nothing is uploaded.

Images: JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF and TIFF out; HEIC, HEIF, BMP and GIF also in.
Video: MP4 and WEBM out, with presets that target real size limits for email
and Discord. Audio: MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A and OPUS, including extracting audio
from video.

HEIC decodes without the paid Microsoft Store HEVC extension.

Quality is preserved rather than fixed: the encoder matches what the source
was saved at, and lossless conversions stay lossless.
